youtube.title: Germany Warned Lusitania's Passengers in the Newspaper. They Sailed Anyway. #shorts
youtube.description:
Case File #037. Before the Lusitania left New York in May 1915, the German Embassy printed a warning in American newspapers. Days later, U-20 sank her off Ireland. Nearly 1,200 died, including 128 Americans.

Sources: History Hit; Ghosts of DC (NYT, 1 & 8 May 1915).
Images: public domain; sinking illustration CC BY 2.0.
